summary: Hang Feng Technology Innovation Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a notice of an extraordinary general meeting and proxy card. The EGM proposes a share capital reclassification and re-designation of ordinary shares into Class A and Class B ordinary shares, along with a share capital increase. The board recommends a FOR vote. This is a routine corporate governance matter involving capital structure changes, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event is present. The filing is a foreign private issuer's notice of shareholder meeting and proxy solicitation. What to watch: shareholder approval of the reclassification.
